description: Put me in a movie — full cinematic film look matching specific film genres. Choose: neon-noir action thriller, 80s finance excess, comic-book superhero blockbuster, video-game key art, or generic action thriller. Returns the styled prompt stack for your shot — pair it with generate_image.

style.description: neon_noir_action = wet streets + neon + anamorphic. glamour_finance_excess = 1980s Wall Street mahogany / gold. superhero_blockbuster = comic-book key art. video_game_character = Unreal-Engine character render. generic_action_thriller = ARRI cinematic.

subject.description: What you want to shoot. E.g. "a woman walking through a hotel lobby" or "morning coffee on the balcony".

name: apply_movie_scene
title: Apply Movie Scene
